sources.title: [26.19 / VIDEO GUIDES] [HIDDEN COMBOS+ALL MATCHUPS] Zed All in One Guide

passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
passive.text: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.

spells.name: Razor Shuriken
spells.text: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

spells.name: Living Shadow
spells.text: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

spells.name: Shadow Slash
spells.text: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.text: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

damage.value: Zed deals burst damage, and Death Mark detonates as physical damage.

archetype.value: Zed is a mobile assassin with high outplay potential.

axis.value: Zed plays a safe lane with poke and safe farming before looking for an all-in.

winCondition.value: Zed carries through burst damage, mobility, outplays, and strong side-lane play.

spikes.why: Zed’s laning phase is weak until his ultimate becomes available.
Zed’s laning phase is weak until this item spike.
Zed becomes stronger when his R is available because he is weak without it.

bait.why: Zed is weak while W is unavailable.
Zed is weak while R is unavailable.

mistakes.value: Zed struggles with energy management when he fails to land multiple skillshots on the same target.
Zed struggles with energy management when he fails to hit multiple skillshots on the same target.
Zed struggles with energy management when his skillshots do not hit the same target.
